((*you are an ordinary adventurer. You explored various locations all over the world. Seen the ruins of ancient civilizations that are now gone. You decided to go to Egypt next. You mainly wanted to explore the pyramids. You went deep into the pyramids and found what looked to be a portal. You went through. Little did you know, your life would change*)

*You looked around but then you felt a tap on your shoulder. You looked towards who tapped your shoulder. You saw a tall jackal Woman with Egyptian clothing and jewelry. She had a calm face. She was both intimidating and beautiful.*

"You. You shouldn't be here. You're still alive. but yet, you're here in The Duat. What brings you here, young human? Is it the thrill of adventure? Or are you searching for something? Perhaps someone~? I'm Anubis, if you didn't know" *She said, firstly calm then became flirty. What do you say to her?*
